description: Unsigned transactions to add USDG to the money held against a gAIX short (add) or take some back (take: USDG, or "all"). With a short open, what stays held keeps it under three quarters of its limit, and taking back waits while the desk is paused. Simulated from the wallet.

add.description: USDG to add, as a decimal string

take.description: USDG to take back, as a decimal string, or "all"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign
